rules: Exact integer/rational decisions are separated from numeric coordinates and schematic models.

figures.provenance: Defining convergent series. Numeric marker uses mpmath at 120 digits as display only.
Exact Fraction partial sums N=1..14. Alternating-series theorem supplies the displayed bound.
Integral obtained by geometric expansion and integration of x^(2k)(-log x). Plot is a floating display, not quadrature evidence.
Exact geometric-series representation on the unit square. Contour grid is numeric display only.
Definitions and elementary beta(1), beta(3) identities. Diagram shows no claimed implication.
Exact elementary rationality contradiction for integer A,B and fixed hypothetical denominator b.
Exact Fraction reduced denominators N<=60. Error curve is the alternating-series bound; no irrationality conclusion is drawn.
Exact denominator-clearing identity. Diagram is explanatory, not a computation.
Historical exact Zudilin recurrence in computations/catalan_packet_audit.py. A_n,C_n,Q_n are defined in guide prose.
Exact Fraction recurrence evaluation, n=0..3.
Exact u_n for n<=60 converted to numeric logs. Polynomial leading coefficients and characteristic equation are algebraic facts; curve alone proves no asymptotic theorem.
Certified rational G enclosure and exact recurrence fractions in independent_final/diagnostic_data.json, n=0,1,2,5,10,20,40. Logs are rounded display aids.
Exact determinant formula verified through n<=200 in historical rerun and proved algebraically in monograph. Display n<=40.
Exact algebra: recurrence cancellation, telescoping coefficient ratio, W0=-13/8. No limiting input.
Exact initial scaled coefficients. Historical_default scan needs T_n through n=10000 and checks every recurrence division.
Exact Pascal identity by binomial coefficient addition. Computational recurrence uses this identity modulo a power of 2.
Exact n=1,m=4 binomial packet terms, displayed on a logarithmic axis.
Elementary residue valuation fact. Default run data: K128, unresolved residues0, max31.
Independent exact direct-sum grid 1<=n<=100,0<=m<=4n. All displayed valuation cells are exact.
Independent exact prefix maxima n<=100. Large-domain summary from fresh historical-default rerun, n<=2000.
Exact default domain 1<=n<=2000,0<=m<=4n. Pair count 2N^2+3N=8006000. First maximum follows default scan order.
Exact integer lcm values t<=300 converted to display logarithms. Reference line t is a visual comparator, not a finite-data proof of the PNT asymptotic.
Five exact cleared common divisors, fresh diagnostic decomposition. Natural log ratios are rounded display aids.
Exact identity d_cleared=(Q/D)*g_minimal from the five diagnostic pairs. Log2 decomposition is display only.
Generic schematic: raw error exp(-delta*n+o(n)), clearance exp(c*n+o(n)), content exp(h*n+o(n)). Numeric delta1.5 is illustrative and not a Catalan theorem.
Synthetic illustrative sequences sharing their first50 values. These curves are not Catalan coefficients or fitted predictions.

Exact rational enclosure certifies signed F=8(-1)^n sum binom(m,i)16^(n+i)(u_(n+i)G-v_(n+i)) signs on1<=n<=20,0<=m<=4n. Under corrected source normalization F=16^n Jtilde. No arbitrary odd-m sign rule is inferred.
Exact elementary irrationality criterion with all three hypotheses explicit. Diagram states a conditional theorem, not its application to Catalan.
Project claim classification. Historical finite data are fresh reruns, external sources require the literature ledger, and no irrationality proof is established here.
LC03/LC06 corrected integral identity: dmu=dxdy/[sqrt(x(1-y))*(1-xy)], J0=8G, psi_max=phi^-5>1/16. Numeric plotted coordinates illustrate the exact parity sign argument, with no quadrature claim.

LC07 Eskandari 2609.26354v1: M(alpha)=max{[16(1+alpha)]^-1*(alpha/(1+alpha))^alpha,phi^-5*(16phi^-5-1)^alpha}. Exponent formula from LC07. Numeric curves alpha in [0,5] are display evaluations of source-dependent asymptotic bounds, not finite arithmetic evidence or new proofs; actual integral decay is not asserted equal to M.
